attributes.title: ASCRS 2027 Annual Meeting
attributes.organizer: American Society of Cataract and Refractive Surgery
attributes.summary:
The ASCRS 2027 Annual Meeting takes place April 2 to 5, 2027, in San Diego, with separate programs for anterior segment surgeons, practice administrators (ASOA) and technicians and nurses. Registration is open, and the early-bird rate ends Friday, January 22, 2027.

Fee amounts and the overall CME statement were not shown on the meeting pages we checked. ASCRS says the new Middle Segment Surgery Day on Friday, April 2, carries up to 6.5 AMA PRA Category 1 Credits.
